runs.text: City of San Angelo 2026 Recycling and Bulk Pickup Schedule
Along with your regular weekly waste collection, we will alternate between collecting recycling or bulk each week. There will be no changes to
normal collection days. Recycling and bulk collection will coincide with your regularly scheduled waste collection day. Each week, residents in the
BLUE shaded map area should expect to have recycling or bulk collected. Refer to the calendar above and/or the region map on the back. You
can view an interactive version of the region map by visiting RepublicServices.com or sanangelo.gov/Trash | 325.481.7726
